scope: Completed three companion sprites, approved provisionally for enlarged detail placement; architectural uncertainty retained.
coordinate_policy: Published representative gazetteer points transcribed exactly; not exact medieval footprints. See per-site precision and uncertainty.
layout_policy: Constantinople stays double size (1024). Smaller companions start at proposed256 atlas pixels; confirm collisions and readable waterways on an enlarged local inset before release. Do not shift geographic anchors to fit artwork; use explicit visual offsets/leader lines if necessary.
